WITH counts_by_staff AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM rental
  GROUP BY staff_id
),
total_rentals AS (
  SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total
  FROM counts_by_staff
),
with_ratio AS (
  SELECT 
    c.cnt,
    CAST(c.cnt AS FLOAT) / t.total AS ratio
  FROM counts_by_staff c
  CROSS JOIN total_rentals t
),
average_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(cnt AS FLOAT)) AS avg_cnt
  FROM with_ratio
),
filtered_rows AS (
  SELECT 
    wr.cnt,
    wr.ratio,
    ac.avg_cnt
  FROM with_ratio wr
  CROSS JOIN average_count ac
  WHERE wr.cnt > ac.avg_cnt
)
SELECT 
  AVG(CAST(cnt AS FLOAT)) AS avg_rental_count,
  AVG(ratio) AS avg_count_divided_by_total,
  AVG(CAST(cnt AS FLOAT) - avg_cnt) AS avg_count_minus_average_count
FROM filtered_rows
